note: NECO Marketing round 6 (R34 top-up): latent and negative demand; the market leader; niche and undifferentiated marketing; selective demand; the perceptual map; family packaging; co-branding and multi-branding; value-based and by-product pricing; cash discount and trade-in allowance; the objective-and-task budget; push against pull; the dealer loader; frequency and prime time; closing the sale; patronage motives; the warranty; SON guarding standards; the rack jobber; the drop shipper; horizontal conflict; the channel captain; the mystery shopper; cart abandonment; the chatbot; customer lifetime value; churn; internal marketing; the letter of credit; counter trade. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-5, WAEC Marketing (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
